environment: Void Linux; native headless Sway, foot; 1440x1000
data: A fixture home of the proof's own: documents (Markdown, text, Python, a 20x40 PNG, a one-page PDF, a second of silence), pictures (a PNG and a notes.md a copy runs into), big (10,000 files), an empty folder; the real files provider; no drives
checks: files from home draws the home folder: documents, pictures, big, the folder's own row this folder and trash; the header reads files . ~; the frame holds in compact, fullscreen, both snaps and the 36x20 minimum
Down to notes.md: the status row holds its line, notes.md . Markdown . its size . the date . ~/documents; the key bar reads back  Esc   actions  ->   preview  Space

Insert checks the lit row and moves the bar down: the status row reads 2 checked with the size, the rows' words stand right of the check sign; Esc with nothing typed clears the checks first and the lit file's line comes back

Right opens the actions page named for the row: copy to a folder, trash, then this folder with new folder and two panes; two panes shows the folder twice with each pane's path on its first row and pane  Ctrl+Tab on the key bar, in compact, fullscreen and both snaps

Ctrl+Tab makes the other pane active: the header names its place, .. opens the folder above there and pictures opens in it alone, Ctrl+Tab comes back to ~/documents with both paths on the panes' first row

With 2 checked the actions read copy to ~/pictures, move to ~/pictures, trash and uncheck all; the copy stops on the conflict page notes.md is in ~/pictures already with skip, keep both and replace; keep both writes notes 2.md and todo.txt, the receipt reads 2 copied to ~/pictures with undo, the other pane reads again, undo takes both back and says put back
move to ~/pictures moves the checked file, the receipt says so, the other pane shows it, undo brings it back
rename opens the prompt with the name as it is and the key bar let go  Esc   save  Enter; Enter renames the file and the row, the receipt says renamed, undo names it back
new folder asks a name for the folder in the prompt; Enter makes drafts on disk and its row reads empty
trash puts the file in the fixture's own Trash/files and says is in the trash with undo; undo brings it back
The PDF previews as its page drawn: the zoom on the facts row and zoom among the keys
The sound previews with the sound's keys, play on Space; nothing is played
Space previews the lit file in the whole window: the Markdown's first line, the picture's 20 x 40 on the facts row; Esc comes back to the two panes as they were with the file lit
one pane under this folder closes the second pane: ~/documents once, no pane key
A folder of 10000 files lists its first page in 1.2 s and End reaches the next page row, with how many more, in 2.9 s; a key pressed meanwhile is answered
With nothing typed Left, Backspace and the header's back go up a level; typed words filter the folder and Esc clears them
